stories.headline: LUNDIN MINING Q1: $380M FREE CASH FLOW AT $5.70/LB REALIZED COPPER — RECORD PRICES HIT THE INCOME STATEMENT
stories.snippet: Lundin Mining (TSX: LUN) reported Q1 2026 adjusted EBITDA of $627M with a 54% margin on May 7, generating $380M in free cash flow from operations. Average realized copper price of $5.70/lb on 80,000 tonnes of production at an all-in cash cost of $1.66/lb produced a $4.04/lb margin — demonstrating how the current copper bull is translating into operating leverage that junior copper explorers are chasing.

stories.headline: SAN LORENZO GOLD HITS ALL-TIME HIGH ON CHILE PORPHYRY STEP-OUT — 102 METRES AT 1.33 G/T FROM HOLE 10
stories.snippet: San Lorenzo Gold Corp. (TSXV: SLG) shares hit an all-time high on May 8 after a 3.9 km step-out at Arco de Oro returned 102 metres at 1.33 g/t gold from 153m, including 13m at 2.21 g/t. VP Exploration Terence Walker said the holes 'indicate a much larger system than earlier thought.' Phase 7 drilling is in permitting, with rig mobilization targeted within 30 days.

stories.headline: GOLD STOCKS CHEAP VERSUS BULLION — FENECK SAYS RECORD CASH FLOW WILL TRIGGER THE NEXT M&A WAVE
stories.snippet: Portfolio manager John Feneck argued on May 8 that gold mining equities are at historically compressed multiples despite record producer margins and surging free cash flow — a setup he says mirrors previous bull market inflection points. Feneck contends rising cash generation will either fuel buybacks or attract acquirers hunting undervalued junior and mid-tier gold assets in the current correction.

stories.headline: STANDARD URANIUM LOCKS IN ATHABASCA DRILL TARGETS — 2 RIGS DEPLOY MAY 31 NEXT TO NEXGEN'S ARROW
stories.snippet: Standard Uranium (TSXV: STND / OTCQB: STTDF) confirmed drill-ready targets at Davidson River in Saskatchewan's southwest Athabasca Basin this week, with two rigs mobilizing May 31 for an 8,000-metre program. The campaign targets the Warrior, Bronco, and Thunderbird conductor corridors adjacent to NexGen's Arrow and Paladin's Triple R — the company's first Davidson River drilling since 2022.

stories.headline: UBS RAISES LITHIUM FORECAST 18% — ENERGY STORAGE DEMAND EXPLODING 60%, DEFICIT OPENS MID-YEAR
stories.snippet: UBS raised its 2026 China spot lithium carbonate price target 18% to 200,000 yuan/tonne on May 7, citing 60% year-on-year growth in energy storage battery (ESS) demand as the dominant market driver. Total demand is forecast at 1.97 million tonnes LCE against risk-weighted supply of 1.91 million tonnes — a projected 65,000-tonne deficit that could widen as AI data centre power demand accelerates ESS deployment.

stories.headline: CHINA SILVER IMPORTS SMASH ALL-TIME RECORDS — 836 TONNES IN MARCH AS SOLAR AND RETAIL BUYING COLLIDE
stories.snippet: China imported 836 tonnes of silver in March 2026, the highest monthly total on record, as surging solar panel manufacturing collided with retail investment panic-buying, per GoldSeek's Gold SWOT analysis. Early 2026 imports already exceeded 790 tonnes through February. PBoC also added 5 tonnes of gold in March — its 17th consecutive purchase — reinforcing central bank demand as a structural floor for precious metals.

stories.headline: COT REPORT MAY 8: SPECULATIVE LONGS WASH OUT IN GOLD AND SILVER — CONTRARIAN SETUP BUILDING
stories.snippet: GoldSeek's weekly Commitment of Traders report for the week ending May 5 shows continued speculative long liquidation in gold and silver following the pullback from Q1 highs near $5,600/oz. Historically, extremes in speculative washout relative to commercial positioning in the COT data have marked high-probability entry points for precious metals — the current setup is approaching those readings.

stories.headline: NDPR OXIDE DROPS 21% IN APRIL AFTER 105% RALLY — CONSOLIDATION BEFORE CHINA'S MID-YEAR QUOTA CALL
stories.snippet: Neodymium-praseodymium oxide fell 21% in April to $99.61/kg after a 105% run from January's open, still leaving NdPr up 88% year-to-date. Analysts see the $95–$115/kg range as a consolidation band through Q2. The pivotal next catalyst is China's mid-year MIIT mining quota announcement — typically released in June — which will determine whether H2 2026 supply tightens or eases for the magnet metals market.

stories.headline: WHITE HOUSE-BACKED RARE EARTH $2.8B DEAL: WILL SERRA VERDE ACTUALLY BREAK CHINA'S MONOPOLY?
stories.snippet: The Diplomat scrutinizes USA Rare Earth's (USAR) $2.8B acquisition of Brazil's Serra Verde Group — the largest Western rare earth M&A deal on record. Central question: Can a 15-year government-backed offtake SPV and the Pentagon's $400M convertible stake in MP Materials (plus a $110/kg NdPr price floor) constitute a credible non-Chinese supply chain, or is this geopolitical posturing ahead of trade talks?

stories.headline: HONEY BADGER SILVER (TSXV: TUF) SURGES 63% TO TOP TSXV WEEKLY GAINERS AS SILVER JUNIORS WAKE UP
stories.snippet: Honey Badger Silver Inc. (TSXV: TUF) posted a 63% weekly gain to top INN's TSXV weekly performers for the week ending May 9, 2026. The move highlights growing speculative interest in small-cap silver juniors as silver demand fundamentals — driven by record Chinese imports and a sixth consecutive annual supply deficit — attract capital to companies with tight share structures and district-scale silver land positions.
